verdict.rationale: Mangopay's payout docs say it sends funds locally and internationally in 24+ currencies. Smart routing always uses the domestic rail when the currency and country match, which avoids wires, and a single RecipientId works per user. FX conversions can be embedded in the workflow. Missing for 10: detailed FX documentation (rates, markups, conversion flow beyond a one-line claim), payout fee and settlement-timing specifics per rail, and independent or hands-on corroboration of local-rail payouts.
